1. This Act may be cited as the Architects (Amendment)
Act, 1972,

2. Section 2 of the Architects Act, 1967 (hereinafter referred
to as "the principal Act") is hereby amended—
(a) by inserting immediately before the definition of
"Architect", the following definition—
‘"appointed date" means the date appointed
under section 1 (2);';
(5) by substituting for the definition of "Architect", the
following—
"Architect" means a person registered under
section 10 (2);';
(c) by deleting the definition of "Public Authority";
(d) by deleting the definition of "Register"; and
(e) by inserting the following new definition—
‘"registered Architectural Graduate" means a
person registered under section 10 (1).'.

(b) Subject to the provisions of this Act, a

the Minister and the Pertubohan Akitek2

registration as an Architect under subsection (2),

(2) Subject to the provisions of this Act the
following persons shall be entitled on application
to be registered under Section A of the Register
as Architects—

(i) any person who—
(a) is a registered Architectural Graduate;

(b) has obtained the practical experience as
prescribed under subsection (1) (5); and

(c) is a Corporate Member of the Pertubohan
Akitek2 Malaysia or has obtained a
qualification which the Board considers
to be equivalent thereto;

(ii) any person who on the appointed date is
registered under Part I of the Architects
Ordinance, 1951;

(ili) any person who was a Corporate Member
of the Pertubohan Akitek2 Malaysia
immediately before the appointed date and
who applies for registration within 12
months of that date and on the date of
application is a Corporate Member of the
Pertubohan Akitek? Malaysia;

(iv) any person who satisfies the Board that he
was practising or was carrying on business
or was employed as a bona fide architect
in East Malaysia for at least 12 months
before the appointed date and who applies
for registration within 12 months of that
date; and

(v) any person who on the appointed date is a
Graduate Member of the Pertubohan
Akitek2 Malaysia or is eligible to become
such a Member and is employed as an
architect in the Federation and who applies

(3) No person who is not practising as an
architect, employed by an Architect or an
architectural firm shall be entitled to be registered
under this Act.".

20. Section 22 of the principal Act is hereby amended—

(a) by substituting the following for subsection (3)—

"(3) The Registrar shall upon receipt of the
prescribed fee issue to any applicant whose
application has been approved by the Board a
certificate of registration in the prescribed form
endorsed with the restrictions that may be
imposed under section 24."; and

(b) by inserting the following new subsection (6)—

"(6) In any proceedings a list published under
subsection (5) shall be prima facie proof that the
persons whose names appear therein are
registered building draughtsmen; and the absence
of the name of any person from the list shall be
prima facie proof that the person is not a
registered building draughtsman.".

21. Section 24 of the principal Act is hereby amended—

(a) by substituting for paragraph (a) of subsection (1),
the following—

"(a) he may submit plans only to, and within the
limits of the Building Authority or Local
Council for which area his application for
registration has been approved; and";

(b) by substituting for subsection (2) the following—

"(2) The Board may at any time on the
application of a registered building draughtsman
vary the restrictions for the time being imposed
upon him pursuant to subsection (1) by substitu-
ting therefor the alternative restriction prescribed
by subsection (5) or by adding thereto or deleting
therefrom any Building Authority or Local
Council specified under paragraph (a) of sub-
section (1)."; and

(c) by substituting the words "the appointed date" for
the words "the commencement of this Act" appear-
ing at the end of the proviso to subsection (5).

22. Subsection (1) of section 25 of the principal Act is
hereby amended by deleting paragraph (e) and by re-
numbering paragraphs (f), (g) and (h) as paragraphs (e), (f)
and (g) respectively.
